services.name: Sunset Scripps Pier Walk
services.desc: Experience Scripps Pier like never before on this exclusive walking tour led by Birch Aquarium! As the sun sets over the Pacific, explore fascinating marine life - like plankton, squid and sharks - and discover groundbreaking research from Scripps Institution of Oceanography. Advanced reservations are required. Participants must be ages 9 and up. All minors (ages 9 - 17) must have their own ticket and be accompanied by a ticketed adult. Children under the age of 9 (including infants and toddlers) are not permitted on the Scripps Pier under any circumstances.
